item.title: Version 0.4.0
item.description:
• Added a License menu in the macOS menu bar with status, refresh, manage, and deactivate actions.
  • Added an in-app License header menu for licensed users so they can view status or deactivate this Mac without hunting through menus.
  • Expanded the License sheet with account, machine name, masked key, activation date, last checked date, refresh status, and a clearer “Deactivate This Mac” action.
  • Updated website download CTAs to use `/download`, so buyers and visitors get the latest DMG directly.
  • Removed the GitHub footer link from the website.
  • Polished the website’s macOS Storage panel preview to more closely match System Settings.
